We need to determine appropriate charge(s) based on facts. The case: Zhao 3, a village representative (农某甲) handling deposit/withdrawal for villagers. He took deposits, got real deposit certificates, forged fake certificates, gave to villagers, then used real certificates to withdraw money for personal use. Made 58 fake certificates, amount 1.0188 million yuan, returned 62,000 yuan. The prosecution argues fraud (诈骗) and not misappropriation (挪用资金). So the correct charge is 诈骗 (诈骗). Possibly also "伪造、变造、买卖国家机关公文、证件、印章"? He forged bank deposit certificates (which are bank documents, not state documents). The list includes "伪造、变造、买卖国家机关公文、证件、印章" which is about state documents, not bank certificates. So not applicable.

Thus only charge: 诈骗.
